initialized the new 'data_size' variable.
I'm not sure how it ever worked
column2: but it might have worked almost by

column1: accident - gcc seems to occasionally miss these kinds of 'variable used
uninitialized' situations
column2: but I've seen it do so because it ended up

column1: zero-initializing them due to some other simplification.
But clang is very unhappy about it all
net/netfilter/nf_tables_api.c:8278:4: error: variable 'data_size' is uninitialized when used here [-Werror

unsigned int size
